records.text: I remember when we met with Ye (Kanye West)'s team and they told us that the inspiration behind that beautiful death that he's talking about, that portion, was actually a scene from the movie 300 when the Spartan climbs over the mountaintop and he sees that there are thousands upon thousands of their enemies marching toward them,
records.speaker: Candace Owens
